transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, August 29. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'Biggest oil deal in history': Trump announces US control of 65bn barrels in Venezuela. Trump said the deal was negotiated by Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth and Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez. He announced the agreement in a social media post. The announcement comes almost nine months after the US military, acting on Trump's orders, carried out an operation to capture Venezuela's President Nicolás Maduro. Maduro was taken to the US to face federal charges related to narcoterrorism, drug trafficking. SIMs, WhatsApp, Dubai route: How Delhi couple aided Pakistan-linked espionage. Delhi Police arrested a city couple for their alleged involvement in anti-national acts. The couple supplied Indian SIM cards used for espionage activities by ISI-backed entities. They procured and sent eight SIM cards to Pakistan via Dubai for payment. Sahil was also tasked with recruiting individuals for reconnaissance and gathering military information. BCCI stance on Sports Bill creates confusion within Board. State cricket associations find themselves perplexed as the BCCI navigates the National Sports Governance Act. The board asserts that its electoral procedures must reflect its constitution, challenging the government's notice that allows for elections to be postponed until December 2026. This discord highlights key issues surrounding cooling-off periods for officials and conflict of interest regulations, clouding the governance framework across various state cricket bodies. Pak drone detected in J and K's Poonch, security forces put LoC sector on high alert. Security forces are on high alert after a Pakistani drone was detected near the LoC. Military personnel tracked the unmanned aerial vehicle over the Rajouri sector on Friday evening. This incident follows several other suspected drone sightings reported in Jammu and Kashmir recently. Security forces have intensified search operations in forward areas to detect any dropped materials. In 1996, MapQuest put maps online before Google Maps; now it rejects 'Lake America'. MapQuest is resisting President Trump's effort to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America. The online mapping service gained significant attention for its humorous response to the proposal. This renaming attempt follows a similar executive order concerning the Gulf of Mexico. Trade tensions between the United States and Canada have reignited the dispute. Bangladeshi illegal who broke into Saif Ali Khan's home and knifed him pleads guilty. Shariful Islam, accused in the Saif Ali Khan attack, has pleaded guilty. He seeks leniency from the court after charges were framed. The accused is facing severe charges for armed robbery and attempted grievous hurt. Islam illegally entered India and attacked the actor and others with a weapon. 'India messed up big time': Ex-captain sounds alarm after costly Colombo blunder. India's ambitions for World Test Championship qualification took a blow following a drawn Test match in Colombo. This result denied them a chance to sweep the series against Sri Lanka. Cricketer Krishnamachari Srikkanth expressed concerns about the implications for the team's future. With only seven matches left, India must secure victories in at least six to stay in contention for the title. Zohran Mamdani forms business council as JPMorgan, BlackRock, Google and others push back. Mayor Zohran Mamdani has established a new Business Advisory Council. This group includes fifteen prominent business leaders from various sectors. Some major corporate executives declined to join the new council. The council will meet quarterly to offer strategic guidance to the mayor. Delhi model murder: Accused Imran was booked for sexually harassing minor in 2018. A gym trainer accused of murdering a young woman was injured in a police encounter. He opened fire at officers while resisting arrest in Rajouri Garden. Police retaliated, and three bullets struck the suspect in his legs. Investigators are probing his social media activity and past criminal cases. Houston lawyer buys $15.5M mansion to demolish it for a garden. In River Oaks, Houston lawyer Tony Buzbee has bought a mansion primarily for property expansion. Teaming up with Habitat for Humanity, he aims to salvage valuable construction materials, which will provide substantial support, millions of pounds worth, for affordable housing projects. The planned demolition will allow for the development of a larger private garden estate while enhancing his family's legacy through philanthropic efforts. Belgian farmer hasn't irrigated crops for 26 years, but soil stays moist. Belgium's Diederik Steyaert has successfully farmed without irrigation for over two decades. His dedication to organic practices ensures that the soil remains healthy and retains moisture efficiently. By eliminating ploughing and incorporating organic matter, Steyaert cultivates robust plants that adapt to stress and drought. This innovative approach showcases vital strategies for addressing agricultural challenges in water-limited environments.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Raksha Bandhan 2026: Tears And Smiles As Sisters Tie Rakhis To Inmate Brothers In MP's Ashoknagar Jail. Raksha Bandhan brought emotional reunions to MP's Ashoknagar jail as sisters tied rakhis to inmate brothers during specially arranged meetings. MP's Biaora Bus Horror Leaves 4 Dead, Karnataka Cyber Crime Inspector Among Victims. Four people, including Karnataka Police cyber crime inspector Ravi K B, were killed and 12 injured after an Indore-bound bus lost control and hit a bridge safety wall in MP's Biaora on Friday morning. CM Yadav's Jan Vishwas Abhiyan Puts Officers On Toes, Pending Complaints Tumble Across MP. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav's Jan Vishwas Abhiyan has accelerated the disposal of long-pending public grievances across Madhya Pradesh. Bhopal Master Plan Back On Track After Years Of Delays, Draft Release Chances Brighten. The Madhya Pradesh government has revived efforts to release Bhopal's long-pending master plan, with experts and public representatives likely to be consulted before the draft is finalised. MP Agniveers Set To Get Up To 10 percent Quota In Police, Forest, Jail and Excise Jobs. Madhya Pradesh is set to provide up to 10 percent reservation to Agniveers in uniformed services, including police, jail, forest, excise and transport departments. 'Take care of the children': The final call from 29 Bhopal pilgrims trapped in Nepal floods. Bengaluru police inspector dies in Madhya Pradesh bus crash during cybercrime probe. Tulsi Saplings Spread Message Of Harmony During Milad-un-Nabi Procession In Indore. Muslim Rashtriya Manch members distributed Tulsi saplings during the Milad-un-Nabi procession in Indore, promoting brotherhood, social harmony and environmental conservation. Madhya Pradesh reels under heatwave as temperature climbs to 45.8 degrees; alerts issued for 25 districts. Madhya Pradesh government orders inquiry into maternal death at Rewa Medical College. MP govt to continue e-attendance in schools after positive impact. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and Madhya Pradesh CM lay foundation stone of T Akashvani News. Bhopal farmers' protest video falsely shared as UGC roll back protests in Delhi. Indore Guard Slapped, Threatened And Then Mowed Down After Argument, Youth And Female Friend Held. Indore police arrested Raja Kumawat and his female friend Shalini alias Sejal Tiwari after security guard Dharmendra Malviya was allegedly deliberately mowed down following an argument at La Exotica Colony. 8-yr-old watches dad kill brother, reports crime to cops. Threads Of Love, Faith and Togetherness Paint Indore In Raksha Bandhan Colours. Indore celebrated Raksha Bandhan with faith, family reunions and community initiatives on Friday. Bengaluru Police Inspector Dies in Madhya Pradesh Bus Accident. Two doctors suspended over death of pregnant woman at government hospital in Madhya Pradesh.
